data.gender_notes: Ernestus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name 'Ernestus', meaning 'earnest' or 'resolute'. The name was popularized by the saints Ernest of Swabia and Ernest of Cologne. Ernestus is a name of great strength and determination, reminding us of the importance of staying true to our convictions. The name Ernestus carries the meaning “Resolute, constant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ernestus usually hope their child will grow to embody resolute, constant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
